subject: maths
question: A dealer buys an old cooler listed at ₹650 and gets successive discounts of 20% and 10%. He spends ₹38 on its repairs and sells it at a profit of 20%. Find the selling price of the cooler.
solution:
Given:

Marked price = Rs. 650

Discounts = 20% and 10%

The cost of repairs = Rs. 38

Selling profit = 20%

Formula used:

C.P. = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × M.P.

S.P. = C.P. × [(100 + Profit%)/100]
